game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the town guard must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell. Each round, siege rats strike the market bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the market bell from siege rats in Tavern Quarter: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Tavern Quarter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Tavern Quarter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while energy > 0.
